name: Mmemme AI na Python maka Ndị Mmalite
objectives: Na Google Colab, ịkọwa otu model AI si dị iche na koodu nwere iwu, na ibubata ma ọ bụ wụnye library Python, site n'ịkọwa ya nke ọma n'otu ahịrịokwu, library ahụ ebuba n'enweghị error

Mgbe e nyere gị mkpụrụ okwu (keyword) na nzaghachi maka chatbot dị mfe, iji ngwa string na dictionary jikọta ozi na nzaghachi ziri ezi, na-ejikọta ya n'agbanyeghị mkpụrụ edemede ukwu, na-enyekwa nzaghachi nkịtị (default) mgbe ọ dịghị ihe dabara

Mgbe e nyere gị function nzaghachi gị, ide loop mkparịta ụka na-akwụsị mgbe onye ọrụ kwuru bye, na ịkọwa oke nzaghachi nwere iwu, loop ahụ na-apụ na bye, ma nwee opekata mpe otu ọmụmaatụ iwu ndị ahụ enweghị ike ijikwa
Site n'iji pipeline Hugging Face, ibubata model sentiment a zụrụla azụ, ịgba ya n'otu ahịrịokwu, na ịgụ label na score ya, mgbe ị gụchara kaadị model ahụ, ma gụọ label na score ahụ nke ọma

Mgbe e nyere gị ndepụta okwu, ịgba model ahụ n'okwu ọ bụla site na loop, ịgụta label ndị ahụ, na igosipụta nchịkọta doro anya, ọnụọgụ ndị ahụ dabara na label ndị ahụ, a gbachakwara score n'ọnụọgụ ntụpọ abụọ

Mgbe e nyere gị azịza model ahụ, ịkara azịza ndị dị n'okpuru threshold obi ike ka mmadụ lelee ha, na ịgbaso omume AI nwere ọrụ, a kara score ọ bụla dị n'okpuru threshold "check by hand", ọ dịghịkwa ozi nzuzo ma ọ bụ key na notebook ahụ

chapters.name: Isi 1: Ihe nkwado Python maka AI

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ihe mmemme AI bụ, na ịhazi Colab
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kọwaa ihe model AI bụ ma bubata library Python na Colab.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Na Google Colab, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa otu model AI si dị iche na koodu nwere iwu, na ibubata ma ọ bụ wụnye library Python, site n'ịkọwa ya nke ọma n'otu ahịrịokwu, library ahụ ebuba n'enweghị error.
Mmemme nkịtị pụtara na ị na-ede iwu ọ bụla n'onwe gị: ọ bụrụ na okwu ahụ bụ "hi", kwuo "hello". Mmemme AI pụtara na ị na-eji model: mmemme mụtara usoro (pattern) site n'ọtụtụ ọmụmaatụ, ya mere ọ nwere ike ijikwa ọnọdụ ị na-edeghị iwu maka ha.
Ị naghị ewukarị model site na mbido. Ị na-eji library: koodu dị njikere nke onye ọzọ dere ma kesaa. Na Python, ị na-ebubata library site na import. Library AI n'efu a ma ama gụnyere Hugging Face Transformers (model asụsụ), scikit-learn (machine learning ochie) na PyTorch (deep learning).
Google Colab enweelarị ọtụtụ n'ime library ndị a. Ọ bụrụ na otu adịghị, ị na-awụnye ya n'ime cell site na !pip install sochiri aha ya. ! ahụ na-agwa Colab ka ọ gbaa iwu sistemụ kama Python. Colab bụ n'efu, mana a na-ekesa kọmputa ya, ya mere ihe ọ na-enye n'efu nwere oke, o nwekwara ike ịgbanwe.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Meghee colab.research.google.com ma mepụta notebook ọhụrụ.
- N'ime cell, dee: import random
- Ahịrị na-esote: print(random.choice(["rock", "paper", "scissors"]))
- Gbaa ya ugboro ole na ole ma lee ka azịza ahụ si agbanwe.
- Ọ bụrụ na import adaa na "No module named", gbaa !pip install <name> n'ime cell, wee nwaa ọzọ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Model AI: mmemme mụtara usoro site n'ọtụtụ ọmụmaatụ ma nwee ike ịkọ ihe na data ọhụrụ.
- Library: koodu dị njikere ị nwere ike ibubata ma jiri na mmemme nke gị.
- import: okwu Python na-ebubata library.
- pip: ngwa na-awụnye library Python.
- Nwere iwu (rule-based): mmemme ebe mmadụ dere iwu ọ bụla n'aka.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Google Colab: Ajụjụ a na-ajụkarị
Nwaa ugbu a: Na notebook Colab ọhụrụ, bubata library random ma dee mmemme na-ahọrọ otu mgbatị ahụ, nri nta ma ọ bụ isiokwu ọmụmụ na mberede site na ndepụta nwere ise, ma gosipụta ya. Gbaa ya ugboro atọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkọwa ọdịiche dị n'etiti koodu nwere iwu na model AI, na ibubata library na Colab.

options: Koodu dị njikere nke onye ọzọ dere ma kesaa
check.why: Library bụ koodu dị njikere a kesara, nke ị na-ebubata site na import.

check.q: Ị chọrọ iji scikit-learn mana ị maghị ma Colab nwere ya. Gịnị ka ị ga-ebu ụzọ nwaa?
options: Gbaa import sklearn, ma ọ bụrụ na o kwuo "No module named", gbaa !pip install scikit-learn
Dee library ahụ ọzọ n'onwe gị
Dee aha library ahụ n'ime print()
check.why: Colab enweelarị ọtụtụ library; wụnye site na !pip naanị ma ọ bụrụ na import adaa.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: String na dictionary: ụbụrụ chatbot dị mfe
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Jiri dictionary jikọta mkpụrụ okwu dị n'ozi na nzaghachi.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị mkpụrụ okwu (keyword) na nzaghachi maka chatbot dị mfe, ị ga-enwe ike iji ngwa string na dictionary jikọta ozi na nzaghachi ziri ezi, na-ejikọta ya n'agbanyeghị mkpụrụ edemede ukwu, na-enyekwa nzaghachi nkịtị (default) mgbe ọ dịghị ihe dabara.
Mmemme AI na-arụ ọrụ n'ọtụtụ ederede, ya mere ị chọrọ ngwa string ole na ole. message.lower() na-eme ka ederede bụrụ mkpụrụ edemede nta, ka "HELLO" na "hello" dabara. "hours" in message bụ True ma ọ bụrụ na okwu ahụ dị ebe ọ bụla n'ozi ahụ. message.split() na-ekewa ahịrịokwu ka ọ bụrụ list okwu.
Dictionary na-echekwa ụzọ abụọ: key na value, n'ime akara curly. replies = {"hours": "We are open 9 to 5.", "price": "Prices are on our menu page."} Ị na-enweta value site na replies["hours"].
Iji wuo ụbụrụ chatbot, gaa n'ime dictionary site na loop: for keyword, answer in replies.items(): if keyword in message: return answer. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dịghị ihe dabara, laghachi nzaghachi nkịtị dị ka "Sorry, I do not know that yet."
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Mee dictionary nke mkpụrụ okwu na nzaghachi.
- Dee function reply(message).
- N'ime ya, debe message = message.lower().
- Gaa n'ime replies.items() site na loop ma laghachi azịza nke mkpụrụ okwu mbụ a hụrụ.
- Mgbe loop gachara, laghachi nzaghachi nkịtị.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- String: ederede na Python.
- Dictionary: otu ụzọ key: value n'ime akara curly.
- Key: aha ị na-achọ na dictionary.
- Value: ihe e chekwara n'okpuru key.
- .items(): na-enye key na value ọ bụla dị na dictionary, maka loop.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee reply(message) maka ebe mgbatị ahụ, ọba akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ụgbọ ala na-ere nri i chepụtara, nwere opekata mpe mkpụrụ okwu anọ (dịka ọmụmaatụ hours, price, location, contact). Nwalee ya n'ozi atọ, gụnyere otu e dere na mkpụrụ edemede ukwu na otu ọ na-ekwesịghị ịghọta.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iji ngwa string na dictionary jikọta ozi na nzaghachi ziri ezi.

check.q: Gịnị ka "I need help now".split() na-enye?
check.why: split() na-ekewa ahịrịokwu ka ọ bụrụ list okwu.

check.q: Chatbot gị ahụghị mkpụrụ okwu ọ bụla n'ozi ahụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme ka o mee?
options: Gosipụta nzaghachi niile dị na dictionary
Laghachi nzaghachi nkịtị dị ka "Sorry, I do not know that yet."
check.why: Nzaghachi nkịtị na-ejikwa ozi ndị na-adabaghị na mkpụrụ okwu ọ bụla.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ime ka chatbot kwuo okwu, na ịhụ oke ya
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Tinye function nzaghachi gị n'ime loop na-akparịta ụka ruo mgbe onye ọrụ kwuru bye, ma hụ ihe iwu na-enweghị ike ime.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị function nzaghachi gị, ị ga-enwe ike ide loop mkparịta ụka na-akwụsị mgbe onye ọrụ kwuru bye, na ịkọwa oke nzaghachi nwere iwu, loop ahụ na-apụ na bye, ma nwee opekata mpe otu ọmụmaatụ iwu ndị ahụ enweghị ike ijikwa.
Chatbot chọrọ loop: rịọ ozi, gosipụta nzaghachi, ma megharịa. while True: na-emeghari ruo mgbe ebighị ebi, ya mere ị na-etinye ụzọ ọpụpụ: ọ bụrụ na ozi ahụ bụ "bye", gosipụta ekele ọpụpụ ma jiri break pụọ na loop ahụ.
Ugbu a nwalee ya dị ka ezi onye ọrụ ga-eme. Dee "when do you open?" chatbot gị nwere ike ịda, n'ihi na i dere "hours", ọ bụghị "open". Ụzọ ọhụrụ ọ bụla e si ekwu ihe chọrọ iwu ọhụrụ. Nke ahụ bụ oke kacha ukwuu nke mmemme nwere iwu.
Nke a bụ ihe mere model AI ji baa uru: model asụsụ mụtara site n'ọtụtụ nde ahịrịokwu, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịghọta ọtụtụ ụzọ e si ekwu otu ihe ahụ. N'isi na-esote, ị ga-eji otu.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Malite na while True:
- N'ime ya, nweta message = input("You: ")
- Ọ bụrụ na message.lower() == "bye", gosipụta ekele ọpụpụ ma mee break.
- Ma ọ bụghị ya, print("Bot:", reply(message)).
- Nwalee ya n'ụzọ ise dị iche iche e si ajụ otu ajụjụ ahụ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- while True: loop na-aga n'ihu ruo mgbe ihe dị n'ime ya kwụsịrị ya.
- break: na-apụ na loop ozugbo.
- Oke (limit): ihe mmemme na-enweghị ike ime nke ọma.
Nwaa ugbu a: Tinye function nzaghachi gị site na Nkuzi 2 n'ime loop mkparịta ụka na-akwụsị na "bye". Jụọ maka hours n'ụzọ ise dị iche iche. Dee ole chatbot gị ghọtara, wee tinye otu iwu iji dozie otu o mehiere.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iwu loop chatbot nwere iwu na-arụ ọrụ, na ịkọwa ihe mere naanị iwu ji nwee oke.

check.q: Gịnị ka while True: na-eme n'onwe ya?
options: Na-emeghari ruo mgbe ebighị ebi ruo mgbe ihe dị ka break kwụsịrị ya
Na-agba naanị ma onye ọrụ kwuo bye
check.why: while True na-emeghari ruo mgbe ebighị ebi, ya mere ị chọrọ ụzọ ọpụpụ dị ka break.

check.q: Ndị ọrụ na-ede "what time do you close?" mgbe niile, chatbot gị nwere iwu na-adakwa. Gịnị ka nke ahụ na-agwa gị?
options: Chatbot ahụ nwere mperi ide ihe
Ụzọ ọhụrụ ọ bụla e si ekwu ihe chọrọ iwu ọhụrụ, nke ahụ bụ oke chatbot nwere iwu
Ndị ọrụ kwesịrị ide na mkpụrụ edemede ukwu
check.why: Chatbot nwere iwu na-ejikọta naanị iwu i dere; model asụsụ na-ejikwa ọtụtụ ụzọ e si ekwu ihe.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Iji model AI a zụrụla azụ

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ibubata model a zụrụla azụ site na Hugging Face
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Bubata model sentiment n'efu na Colab ma jiri ya n'otu ahịrịokwu.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji pipeline Hugging Face, ị ga-enwe ike ibubata model sentiment a zụrụla azụ, ịgba ya n'otu ahịrịokwu, na ịgụ label na score ya, mgbe ị gụchara kaadị model ahụ, ma gụọ label na score ahụ nke ọma.
Model a zụrụla azụ (pre-trained) bụ nke onye ọzọ zụrụla ma kesaa, ya mere ị nwere ike iji ya ozugbo. Hugging Face bụ weebụsaịtị nwere ọtụtụ puku model n'efu, library Transformers ya na-ebubatakwa ha n'otu ahịrị.
Ngwa kacha mfe bụ pipeline. Ị na-agwa ya ọrụ ahụ na model ahụ: classifier = pipeline("text-classification", model="distilbert/distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english"). Model a na-agụ ederede bekee ma kpebie ma obi (sentiment) ya bụ POSITIVE ma ọ bụ NEGATIVE.
Jiri ya dị ka function: classifier("The practice today was great!"). Ọ na-alaghachi list nwere dictionary n'ime ya, dịka ọmụmaatụ [{'label': 'POSITIVE', 'score': 0.99}]. Score bụ otu model ahụ si ji n'aka, site na 0 ruo 1. Ịgba mbụ na-ebudata model ahụ, ya mere ọ na-ewe ogologo oge ntakịrị.
Gụọ peeji model mgbe niile ("kaadị model" ya) tupu i jiri ya: ọ na-ekwu ihe e ji zụọ model ahụ, ihe ọ bụ maka ya na ikike (licence) ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- N'ime cell ọhụrụ: from transformers import pipeline
- Mepụta classifier = pipeline("text-classification", model="distilbert/distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english")
- Gbaa result = classifier("The practice today was great!")
- print(result[0]["label"], result[0]["score"])
- Ọ bụrụ na transformers adịghị, buru ụzọ gbaa !pip install transformers.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Model a zụrụla azụ: model onye ọzọ zụrụla nke ị nwere ike iji ozugbo.
- Hugging Face: weebụsaịtị na otu library maka ịkesa model AI n'efu.
- pipeline: ngwa Transformers na-ebubata model maka ọrụ n'otu ahịrị.
- Sentiment: obi (mood) dị n'ederede: positive ma ọ bụ negative.
- Score: otu model ahụ si ji n'aka, site na 0 ruo 1.
- Kaadị model: peeji na-akọwa ihe model na-eme, data ya na ikike (licence) ya.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Hugging Face Transformers: Pipelines
- Hugging Face: kaadị model distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english
Nwaa ugbu a: Bubata classifier sentiment ma gbaa ya n'ahịrịokwu atọ i dere: otu nwere obi ụtọ doro anya, otu nwere iwe doro anya, na otu agwakọtara dị ka "The food was good but the wait was long." Gosipụta label na score maka nke ọ bụla ma dee nke o jichaghị n'aka.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ibubata model a zụrụla azụ site na pipeline ma gụọ label na score ya.

check.q: Gịnị ka kaadị model na-agwa gị?
options: Ihe e ji zụọ model ahụ, ihe ọ bụ maka ya na ikike (licence) ya
check.why: Gụọ kaadị model tupu i jiri model.

check.q: Ị gbara classifier ahụ na nke mbụ, o wee were oge. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Chere; ịgba mbụ na-ebudata model ahụ
Gbanwee label ka ọ bụrụ POSITIVE n'aka
check.why: Ịgba mbụ na-ebudata model ahụ, ya mere ọ na-ewe ogologo oge.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Ịgba model ahụ n'ọtụtụ ederede
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Jiri loop kewaa ndepụta okwu ma gụta azịza ndị ahụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ndepụta okwu, ị ga-enwe ike ịgba model ahụ n'okwu ọ bụla site na loop, ịgụta label ndị ahụ, na igosipụta nchịkọta doro anya, ọnụọgụ ndị ahụ dabara na label ndị ahụ, a gbachakwara score n'ọnụọgụ ntụpọ abụọ.
Ezi mmemme na-ejikwa ọtụtụ ederede, ọ bụghị otu. Tinye okwu gị na list, wee mee loop: for comment in comments: result = classifier(comment)[0]. Ị nwekwara ike inye ya list ahụ niile otu mgbe, classifier(comments), ma nweta otu azịza maka okwu ọ bụla.
Iji chịkọta, debe ihe ngụta (counter): positive = 0 na negative = 0 tupu loop ahụ, wee tinye 1 n'onye ziri ezi n'ime ya dabere na result["label"].
Gbachaa score ka ọ dị mfe ịgụ: round(result["score"], 2) na-enye ọnụọgụ ntụpọ abụọ. f-string na-egosipụta ahịrị dị mma: print(f"{result['label']:8} {round(result['score'], 2)} {comment}").
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Tinye opekata mpe okwu ise na list.
- Debe positive = 0 na negative = 0.
- Gaa n'okwu ndị ahụ site na loop ma kewaa nke ọ bụla.
- Gosipụta label, score a gbachara na okwu ahụ.
- Tinye na counter ziri ezi, wee gosipụta ngụkọta mgbe loop gachara.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Counter: variable na-agụta ugboro ole ihe mere.
- round(): na-ebelata ọnụọgụ ka o nwee ọnụọgụ ntụpọ ole a kara aka.
- Batch: otu ìgwè input a na-ejikwa ọnụ.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee okwu isii gbasara klas, omume otu egwuregwu ma ọ bụ ụlọ ahịa dị nso. Kewaa ha site na loop, gosipụta otu ahịrị dị mma maka nke ọ bụla, ma gosipụta ole bụ positive na ole bụ negative.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịgba model AI na list ederede ma chịkọta azịza ya site na counter.

check.q: Gịnị ka classifier(comments) na-alaghachi mgbe comments bụ list?
options: Otu azịza maka list ahụ niile
check.why: Inye list na-alaghachi otu azịza maka okwu ọ bụla.

check.q: N'ime loop gị, result["label"] bụ "POSITIVE". Gịnị ka ị ga-eme na counter gị?
check.why: Tinye 1 na counter dabara na label ahụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Ịlele AI na imecha ihe na-ekewa nzaghachi
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Kaa azịza nwere obere obi ike ka mmadụ lelee ha, ma mechaa ihe na-ekewa nzaghachi.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị azịza model ahụ, ị ga-enwe ike ịkara azịza ndị dị n'okpuru threshold obi ike ka mmadụ lelee ha, na ịgbaso omume AI nwere ọrụ, a kara score ọ bụla dị n'okpuru threshold "check by hand", ọ dịghịkwa ozi nzuzo ma ọ bụ key na notebook ahụ.
Model AI na-eme mperi. Nke a maara naanị positive na negative, ya mere a na-amanye okwu ndị na-anọ n'etiti (neutral) ma ọ bụ agwakọtara ka ha banye n'otu n'ime ha. O nwekwara ike ịghara ịhụ ịkọ nkọ ("Great, another rainy game day."), e jikwa nyocha ihe nkiri bekee zụọ ya, ya mere okwu ntorobịa (slang) ma ọ bụ asụsụ ndị ọzọ nwere ike ime ka mgbagwoju anya.
Ezigbo omume bụ threshold obi ike: ọ bụrụ na score dị n'okpuru ọnụọgụ ị họọrọ, dị ka 0.80, mmemme ahụ na-ekwu "check by hand" (lelee ya n'aka) kama ịtụkwasị label ahụ obi. Mmadụ na-eme mkpebi ikpeazụ n'ihe ọ bụla dị mkpa.
Jiri AI n'ụzọ nwere ọrụ: agbala ozi nzuzo n'ime ngwa n'enweghị ikike, etinyela okwuntughe ma ọ bụ API key na notebook a na-ekesa, ma gwa ndị mmadụ mgbe azịza si n'AI.
Ugbu a i nwere ihe niile maka ọrụ ikpeazụ: list, model, loop, if nwere threshold, counter na ngosipụta doro anya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Họrọ threshold, dịka ọmụmaatụ THRESHOLD = 0.80.
- N'ime loop, lelee: if result["score"] < THRESHOLD:
- Gosipụta "check by hand" n'akụkụ okwu ndị ahụ.
- Gụta positive na negative dị ka mbụ.
- Gosipụta ngụkọta na ole chọrọ ka mmadụ lelee ha.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Threshold: ọnụọgụ oke ị họọrọ; a na-ejikwa azịza dị n'okpuru ya n'ụzọ pụrụ iche.
- Obi ike (confidence): otu model si ji azịza ya n'aka.
- Ịkọ nkọ (sarcasm): ikwu ihe megidere ihe ị pụtara, nke model na-adịghị ahụkarị.
- Mmadụ n'ime loop (human in the loop): mmadụ na-enyocha azịza AI tupu e jiri ha.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Hugging Face: kaadị model distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: wuo ihe na-ekewa nzaghachi. Jiri opekata mpe okwu isii, gụnyere otu agwakọtara na otu nwere ịkọ nkọ. Gosipụta nke ọ bụla na label na score ya, kaa ihe ọ bụla dị n'okpuru 0.80 dị ka "check by hand", ma gosipụta ngụkọta positive, negative na check-by-hand. Wee gụọ ndị a kara akara n'onwe gị ma kpebie.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iwu mmemme AI na Python na-arụ ọrụ nke na-ekewa ederede, na-akọ azịza ya, ma na-enyefe mmadụ ihe ndị o jighị n'aka.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị E bubatara model ma jiri ya Model ahụ anaghị ebuba, ma ọ bụ ọ dịghị label ma ọ bụ score a na-enweta. Model sentiment a zụrụla azụ na-agba ma na-enye label na score maka okwu ọ bụla. Notebook ahụ dere ihe kaadị model kwuru na e ji zụọ ya. Loop na ngosipụta Okwu na-erughị isii, ma ọ bụ a naghị egosipụta okwu ọ bụla na label na score ya. Opekata mpe okwu isii, nke ọ bụla gosipụtara na label ya na score a gbachara. Ngosipụta ahụ kwụ n'ahịrị nke ọma site na f-string. Ngụkọta Ngụkọta positive na negative adịghị ma ọ bụ ezighi ezi. E gosipụtara ngụkọta ziri ezi nke okwu positive na negative. Ọ na-egosipụtakwa ole e kara "check by hand". Threshold obi ike Enweghị threshold, ma ọ bụ a kaghị score dị ala akara. A kara score ọ bụla dị n'okpuru 0.80 "check by hand". Gụnyere okwu nwere ịkọ nkọ ma ọ bụ agwakọtara ma kọwaa ihe mere model ahụ nwere ike ịgha ya. Iji ya n'ụzọ nwere ọrụ Notebook ahụ nwere ozi nzuzo n'enweghị ikike, ma ọ bụ okwuntughe ma ọ bụ API key. Naanị okwu e chepụtara echepụta ma ọ bụ nke e nyere ikike, ọ dịghịkwa okwuntughe ma ọ bụ key na notebook ahụ. Ọ gbakwunyere ndetu na-ekwu na label ndị ahụ si n'AI, nakwa na mmadụ na-elele ndị o jighị n'aka. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.
